source_text: Isaac mittit Iacob ad Laban. Esau addit uxores Chananaeas — amaritudo spiritui parentum.
pass_a_gloss: Isaac sends Jacob to Laban. Esau adds wives Canaanite — bitterness to-spirit of-parents.
pass_b_english: [[Isaac sends Jacob to Laban >> Bible:Genesis 28:1-5]]. [[Esau takes Canaanite wives >> Bible:Genesis 28:8-9]] — bitterness to his parents’ spirit.
